NEOW.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.0-1r: Mmm... I'll be late for rehearsal... Where am I?
NEOW.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.0-3r: Is there a way out up there? I need to get back to everyone.
NEOW.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.1-3r: I won't. This time, I'll remember.
NEOW.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-1r: I was so close... All right, let's try again!
NEOW.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-3r: Thank you. I can't make the same mistake this time.
DARV.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.0-0r: Come on over! All these goodies—there's bound to be something you like!
DARV.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.0-1r: Um... do you have any manga?
DARV.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.0-2r: Books with pictures? Sure! Some of them bite when you open them, though!
DARV.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.0-3r: B-bite? Maybe I'll just look at the covers...
DARV.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.1-0r: That's a pretty little thing you're holding! What would you trade it for?
DARV.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.1-1r: This isn't for trade. I still need it to sing.
DARV.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.1-2r: Oh, oh! Then look at this! It'll carry your voice a LONG way!
DARV.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.1-3r: ...Just checking: it won't bring the ceiling down, will it?
DARV.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-0r: Back again! What are you after this time?
DARV.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-1r: Do you have anything small? I'd like to bring everyone some souvenirs.
DARV.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-2r: Good thinking! All these little things take up so much room. Take your pick!
DARV.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-3r: This color... I think she'd like it.
OROBAS.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.0-: Sparkly! So many colors! Are you a rainbow too?!
No, this is my stage outfit. But you really do look like the lights in a transformation scene!
Transformation?! Into what? A bigger you?!
Well... it's a long story. Have you seen Magic Lulu?
OROBAS.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.1-: That last bit? Okay, follow my beat—
W-wait! We're not at the chorus yet!
OROBAS.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-: Sure. Want to hear the one from last time?
New ones! Old ones! All of them!
Let's pick one for now. I still have a long way to go.
TEZCATARA.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE: Come in, darling! Your voice is all hoarse. Have a little rest.
Continue
Phew... Thank you. I did push my voice a little too hard.
Continue
Have something to eat. Next time, burn all those nasty things to ashes!
Continue
...I was only trying to chase them away.
Anything you dislike about yourself, sweetie? I could burn it away for you.
Continue
I rush the beat when I'm nervous... Can you fix that too?
Continue
Of course! We just need to make sure you never feel nervous again—
Continue
Wait! I think I'd rather practice!
Look at all that energy! Let my fire sing along with you.
Continue
Like the lights on a stage?
Continue
More intense, darling. Something they'll never forget.
Continue
Then... could you keep it away from my hair?
VAKUU.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.0-0: You want an audience, don't you? I could make everyone cheer for you.
VAKUU.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.0-3: ...Wait. They'd cheer even if they didn't like my singing?
VAKUU.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.0-5: It does make a difference. I'd never know whether I was singing well.
VAKUU.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.1-0: Why wait for the others to catch up? I could give you the power of an entire band, all to yourself.
VAKUU.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.1-3: ...But I want to perform with them.
VAKUU.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-0: Failed again. Your dream certainly can take a beating.
VAKUU.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-1: You don't need to remind me. I remember.
VAKUU.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-2: Next time will be no different.
VAKUU.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-3: This time, I won't let her...
TANX.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.0-0r: Where is your weapon?! Show me!
TANX.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.0-2r: That tiny horn?! How will you fight?!
TANX.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.1-0r: Stronger than last time! Good! Keep training!
TANX.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.1-1r: I have been! But my arms are still sore...
TANX.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.1-2r: Soreness is the call to your next battle!
TANX.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.1-3r: No, I think it's telling me to rest!
TANX.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-0r: How strong do you want to become?!
TANX.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-1r: As strong as Magic Lulu! Strong enough to help everyone when it matters!
TANX.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-2r: Magic Lulu?! A warrior's name! What weapon does she wield?!
TANX.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-3r: I could talk about that for hours! ...Oh, right. The Spire first.
NONUPEIPE.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE: At last, a visitor whose clothes aren't so drab. Come, let me take a closer look.
It's my stage outfit! Though it's gotten pretty dirty on the way here...
Never mind that. You could shine even brighter.
Can I keep this bow, though? I really like it.
Wear my blessing. You will see how beautiful power can be.
Like a transformation...! Do I need to say anything?
...Maybe I'll try it when no one's looking.
What would you like to look like this time?
Someone you can tell is the vocalist at a glance!
I need to be able to run and jump, too... Preferably without stepping on my skirt.
PAEL.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.0-0r: That song... is that you singing...?
PAEL.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.0-1r: Oh, I'm sorry! Did I wake you?
PAEL.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.0-3r: Okay. I'll sing this part quietly.
PAEL.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.1-1r: Yes. Sometimes I dream of a huge stage, with everyone there.
PAEL.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.1-2r: That sounds... like a dream worth staying in...
PAEL.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.1-3r: But when I wake up, it makes me want to rehearse even more.
PAEL.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-0r: You're tired... sleep here for a while...
PAEL.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-1r: I'll just sit for a bit. I'm afraid I won't get up if I fall asleep.
PAEL.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_ARALE.2-3r: I can't. There are people I still need to see.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ARALE_MOD_CHARACTER_A: Do you know why you came here?
...I haven't quite figured that out yet.
Then do you still remember who you are?
Nakamachi Arale. The vocalist of Mugendai MewType. I remember that.
She told you to kill me, and so you came?
A lot of people have said that on the way here.
I'm here to settle things with Viola while I'm at it.
What do you intend to do once you leave this place?
Find everyone first. Then... there's so much I want to tell them.
Rehearse, too. If I don't practice soon, they'll definitely hear the difference.
